"Ava's Children", a long-respected Grineer charity program to feed starving off-world orphans, has come to our attention through an anonymous tip. Here is what we know:

A Grineer noble named Ava Izar started the program as a political podium. During the airing of her (now legendary) "Plea for the Forgotten" Ava's tear-duct implants malfunctioned. Stunned audiences mistook this as an emotional display, winning her the hearts and minds of the Grineer people. Now, under her direct supervision, the “charity program” operates as a front for child labor, producing the majority of Grineer munitions. The children, including Tenno, live shortened lives in orbital labor camps.

Infiltrate the ship carrying Izar to a political rally and eliminate her.

Ava's political career exploded when she launched "Ava's Children", a charity program to feed starving off-world orphans. /DS/Language/Notes/NewStartLetterA:
''My dearest Sasha,
It is been two horrifying weeks since the 'stdraashna' night. We - the few of us who succeeded in escaping at the very last moment - have been roaming about without sleeping at night, since death threatens us every moment. Out of the sewers and back into the sewers. We have become sewer rats.<page>
Still, some have become organized. They barter for food, safe shelter, and weapons. Unfortunately, I have very little of value to them and I cannot risk going into the streets to scavenge. The army takes no chances with civilians, and death is preferable to facing the other threats.<page>
Every moment I expect to be killed. Tonight I will make one last attempt to make it out of the city through the immigration docks. I do not think it will be successful.
I am sitting in a drained canal where your grandfather used to fish and I am writing you this farewell letter. By luck, may it find its way to you. I send you my fatherly blessing before my death.
S.C.''

Forever.
Farewell brother.
Dimtri Menshik, November 16th 1987.''
